name: clipnode-media-mcp
description: MCP bridge for ClipNode local media edit service.

interface.shortDescription: Control ClipNode local media export through MCP.
interface.longDescription: Adds MCP tools, a workflow resource, and a workflow prompt that expose ClipNode local media capabilities, phone media browsing, file upload/download, task validation, serial export jobs, HLS m3u8 to MP4 export, job status, outputs, transition tags, sticker animation capabilities, and built-in reference templates.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use ClipNode Media MCP as a local video editing workflow: read capabilities, upload/probe sources, validate the task, create one queued job, poll status, then download successful outputs. Prefer the MCP tools over manual curl checks. Do not use sandboxed curl/wget/ad-hoc HTTP scripts for CLIPNODE_BASE_URL, localhost, LAN, Android device, emulator, or ADB-forwarded endpoints; if a real HTTP request is necessary, request sandbox_permissions=require_escalated and explain the endpoint, purpose, and expected effect.
